description: A single pending household invite: household identity, who invited you, expiry status, and the accept action. The invite code stays internal and is never rendered.

householdName.description: Household display name; falls back to 'Household'.

inviterEmail.description: Email of the inviter; renders 'Invited by {email}' when present.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 expiry timestamp; drives the status chip and expired ghost bar.

expired.description: True when expiresAt is in the past; hides the CTA and shows the ghost bar.

accepting.description: True while this invite's accept request is in flight; CTA shows spinner and is disabled.

onAccept.description: Invoked on Accept & Join tap; triggers the existing confirm-dialog accept flow.

accessibility.label: {householdName}, invited by {inviterEmail}, {statusWord}
accessibility.notes: Card reads as one node; the accept action carries its own button role and busy/disabled state. The raw invite code is never exposed to assistive tech.
